title: Stripe moves to 23.2.0 and the API version pin moves to 2026-11-18.endive as a deliberate decision

source.ref: Split out of Dependabot #5464 (minor-and-patch group) on 2026-11-25 by the open-PR sweep

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: Dependabot #5464 bumped stripe ^23.1.0 -> ^23.2.0, which ships API version 2026-11-18.endive, so HYG-220's pin probe failed. The other 15 minor/patch updates shipped without it. Do this after the Founding Year checkout (LIVE-2541) is live and tested: read the 2026-11-18 changelog, move STRIPE_API_VERSION and the SDK together, and supersede HYG-220's probe in the same PR (ADR-1936 makes the version a billing decision).

verify.note: Fails today (pin and SDK at 2026-10-28.endive); passes once both move to 2026-11-18.endive.
